text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To my dearest big brother.
I have an important matter to discuss regarding what comes next."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To my dearest big sister.
I have an important matter to discuss regarding what comes next."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Please check the next message for details.
See you tomorrow at 11:00. - Curren"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A message suddenly sent late at night.
I can sense an extraordinary seriousness from the text...
Could it be about consulting for the Senior Class?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No, this is Curren Chan we're talking about.
It might have nothing to do with racing at all."
With that internal struggle lingering, the next day arrived—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks for coming, Big Brother.
To get right to the point, what I wanted to talk about is...”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks for coming, Big Sister.
To get right to the point, what I wanted to talk about is...”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Senior Year, I gathered intel on the rivals
who are likely to stand in Curren's way, so I wanted to report it to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan looked unusually serious.
Realizing I needed to brace myself as well,
I straightened my posture to face her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Curren will now share
all the info she's gathered with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you notice anything, Big Brother,
be sure to tell me right away.
Well then—shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you notice anything, Big Sis,
please let me know right away.
Well then—shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan brought along what looked like her personal tablet.
Placing it on the table, she started playing a video she had edited...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ‘Haaahhh!!!’

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Housing the flame of justice within my heart!
Rushing to the rescue in a pinch to outrun evil!
Biko Pegasus has arrived!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—She is Biko Pegasus.
According to Curren's research, it looks like she's thinking of running in next year's Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's someone Curren will be
clashing with before long. And—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Alright everyone!
Let's have fun today too! Let's—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: “Umatok!!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Biko-chan's main battlefield is UmaTok.
Her short videos tied to tokusatsu and anime
are a huge hit with kids and hardcore fans alike.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You could say they're a "Tokusatsu-style UmaTokker"
...I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ""...Oh, has it started already?""

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"‘Every day is Bono!
Big and delicious is always good♪
I'm Hishi Akebono~♪’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—She is Hishi Akebono.
Curren's friend, and an amazing cook. Putting that talent of hers to good use...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"In today's Umasta Live stream,
I'll be making that cute flower cake
that was requested♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: She posts these huge, cute, but delicately decorated cakes and hot pots, and they're super popular!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: When I ran with Flower-chan before, it was mainly neat little bento boxes, but Akebono-san really has no genre limits.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now she's carved out her own genre as a "Cooking Umastagrammer."
Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay, pausing here~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
?
Didn't you say info on our rivals?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They might say that, but...
to me, it just looks like they're introducing popular Tracen Academy Umamusume on social media.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If that's everything, moving right along~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Howdy!
Hello, everyone!
Taiki Shuttle here!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—She is Taiki Shuttle.
A super cheerful and bright "lifestyle UmaTuber."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Today, we bring you an exciting
guerrilla BBQ party, ya hear!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A loooot of big steaks have arrived
from my home!
Let's grill 'em up under the blue sky!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A lively, dynamic daily life matching her big-hearted personality,
streamed in heaps on UmaTube.
It's a massive hit with people of all ages.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Ta-i-ki...! How many times do I have to tell you that you cannot have a barbecue on school grounds?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, looks like our first guest is already here!
A familiar face to everyone, no doubt.
It's Air Groove!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Don't just make me a guest without asking!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see...
'B-r-e-a-k-i-n-g-s-c-h-o-o-l-r-u-l-e-s
is absolutely! Forbidden!' ...there."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Alright!! Upload complete!
AHAHAHA! Now it's absolutely perfect!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
""I really am such an exceptional class representative, aren't I!
Not satisfied with just my daily duties as class rep...""

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
""Promoting the school rules every day on Umatter to all the folks online like this!
I really am something! Good job, me! All hail the Honorary Committee Chairperson!""

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—The one who just explained all of that was
the "Class Rep Extraordinaire,"
Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh my, a notification already!
Could it be praise from a student
moved by my Umart?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
""Wait! The post says
"School rules must be broken!"~!?
I accidentally hit send before finishing it—!!""

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san is gaining massive momentum as a buzzworthy Umastagrammer,
thanks to her terrifying typos and countless airheaded posts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...So with that, all the rivals have assembled, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Personally, Curren's pretty interested in
Akebono-san, since she's a fellow Umastagrammer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big sister?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh, looks like big bro hasn't noticed, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh, looks like big sis hasn't noticed, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, when you line up the members that just came up...
Doesn't something stand out to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The ones who stepped forward were Biko Pegasus,
Hishi Akebono, Taiki Shuttle,
and Sakura Bakushin O. Their common thread is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Spot on♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And convenient enough for Curren, the top stars of Umastagram, Umitter, and Umatok... are all gathered in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If Curren joins the mix...
creating excitement beyond the Derby, Tenno Sho, or Arima Kinen won't just be a dream.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true.
Curren will make it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you win on the most thrilling stage...
then that girl is definitely the "cutest Umamusume of all," right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Next year, I'll take on all of them, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Next year, I'm taking on all of them, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The details are still in the works!
Look forward to loooots of fun stuff
in your Senior year too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is up to something...
It was a day that made me feel I should prepare myself mentally for whatever might happen.
